note: 17 visual styles adapted from Majed Video. Each style defines the visual language for a video: palette, fonts, surface, personality.

keynote.name: كينوت
keynote.desc: فراغ كبير، كلمة وحدة تحمل المشهد، حركة قليلة مضبوطة
keynote.label: clean

glassUI.name: زجاج الواجهة
glassUI.desc: إشعارات وكروت وويدجت بمادة زجاجية فوق الفيديو
glassUI.label: notif

explainer.name: شرح صحفي
explainer.desc: ورق ودبابيس وقلم تحديد وخيط أحمر — المعلومة تطلع موثّقة
explainer.label: highlight

paperCut.name: ورق مقصوص
paperCut.desc: كل شي قصاصة ورق بحد أبيض وظل قاسي — ستوب موشن
paperCut.label: slap

archive.name: وثائقي
archive.desc: حبيبات فلم، ملف مانيلا، آلة كاتبة، ختم أحمر، وكن بيرنز بطيء
archive.label: stamp

editorial.name: مجلة
editorial.desc: غلاف مجلة: عنوان ضخم ورا الراس، خطوط رفيعة، أرقام صغيرة بالزوايا
editorial.label: masthead

swiss.name: سويسري
swiss.desc: شبكة صارمة، أحمر وأسود وأبيض، أشرطة وأرقام ضخمة، بلا زخرفة
swiss.label: bar

doodle.name: رسم يد
doodle.desc: أسهم ودوائر بقلم تنرسم وهي تلحق الكلام، والخط «يغلي» شوي
doodle.label: circled

terminal.name: تيرمنال
terminal.desc: نافذة كود داكنة، مؤشر يومض، أوامر تنكتب ونتايج تطلع
terminal.label: prompt

riso.name: ريزو
riso.desc: حبرين فلورسنت متراكبين مزحزحين، ونقاط هافتون — طباعة يدوية
riso.label: misreg

newsprint.name: جريدة
newsprint.desc: ورق جرايد، عنوان عريض، أعمدة رفيعة، وأحمر للعاجل بس
newsprint.label: headline

blueprint.name: بلوبرنت
blueprint.desc: أزرق وشبكة قياس، خطوط تنرسم وأسهم أبعاد وcallouts تأشر
blueprint.label: callout

vhs.name: VHS
vhs.desc: شاشة قديمة: خطوط مسح ونزيف ألوان وOSD — لحظات «زمان» بس
vhs.label: osd

brutal.name: بروتالي
brutal.desc: ألوان صارخة، حدود سودة عريضة وظل قاسي، ضربة واهتزاز — للهوك والطلب بس
brutal.label: boxed

studio3D.name: ستوديو منتج
studio3D.desc: خلفية كريمية بإضاءة ناعمة، اسم بارز كأنه مجسّم مطفي، وتاق أسود صغير
studio3D.label: extrude

stickerToon.name: ستيكر كرتوني
stickerToon.desc: باستيل وحدود سودة ثابتة السماكة، فقاعات وماسكوت ينط — مرح
stickerToon.label: pill

devCard.name: كرت أداة
devCard.desc: كريمي بشبكة وأشعة، كرت أبيض، breadcrumb، كلمة أكسنت بالرقعة وchips
devCard.label: chip

woodcut.name: Woodcut print
woodcut.desc: Black relief print on laid paper: carved line screen, ragged knife edge, wood-grain streaks and specks where ink did not take, a ragged block edge, and at most one mottled copper plate for the thing that burns.
woodcut.useFor: Folk tales, craft brands, book trailers, serious history.

risograph.name: Risograph
risograph.desc: True three-plate riso: blue / yellow / fluorescent-pink spot inks separated from the frame, angled halftone screens, per-plate misregistration, ink grain, roller feed streaks and pinholes in the solids on warm paper. Overprints mix green, violet and orange.
risograph.useFor: Zines, indie brands, event posters, playful explainers.

ink-wash.name: Ink wash (sumi-e)
ink-wash.desc: Black ink in five tones on fibrous rice paper: wet washes with pigment-edged bleed, dry wobble, long paper fibres, and one vermilion seal accent kept in colour.
ink-wash.useFor: Calm, poetic, nature, East-Asian themes, meditation and craft stories.

pixel-8bit.name: 8-bit pixel
pixel-8bit.desc: Chunky 8 px pixels snapped to a 16-colour palette with ordered Bayer dither, steps on twos — any motion becomes a retro game cutscene.
pixel-8bit.useFor: Games, nostalgia, playful product moments, developer humour.

comic-halftone.name: Comic halftone
comic-halftone.desc: Pop-art print: punchy posterised colour, ink outlines, a real 45° dot screen grown into the midtones and a cyan misregistered plate ghost.
comic-halftone.useFor: Punchlines, launches, pop culture, energetic social clips.

watercolor.name: Watercolour
watercolor.desc: Field-journal watercolour: translucent pigment washes that pool darker just inside every edge (tide line), dry-brush flying-white streaks, granulation in the cold-press tooth, gentle wobble; paper is the only white.
watercolor.useFor: Children’s stories, travel, wellness, gentle brand films.

neon-noir.name: Neon noir
neon-noir.desc: Night-city grade: crushed blacks, magenta/cyan split, threshold-gated bloom with magenta halation, chromatic fringe, rain-wet sheen and grain.
neon-noir.useFor: Tech launches, music, gaming, cyber themes, night scenes.

crt-terminal.name: CRT terminal
crt-terminal.desc: Green phosphor monitor: monochrome green ramp, phosphor bloom, scanlines whose glow pools in bright areas, curved glass bezel with glare and a rolling bar.
crt-terminal.useFor: Hacker/dev themes, retro computing, logs and data, sci-fi interfaces.

pencil-sketch.name: Pencil sketch
pencil-sketch.desc: Graphite on sketch paper: soft grey edges, light diagonal hatching in the shade, boiling line wobble on twos, paper fibre.
pencil-sketch.useFor: Storyboards, ideation, "drawing it out", education and explainers.

cyanotype.name: Cyanotype
cyanotype.desc: Sun-print blue: Prussian-blue to paper-white ramp, chemical coating streaks, soft grain and a brushed deckle border.
cyanotype.useFor: Botany, science history, calm product stories, archival looks.

film-noir.name: Film noir
film-noir.desc: High-contrast black-and-white cinema print: deep shadows, silver highlights, gate weave, scratches and dust, grain and 2.39:1 bars.
film-noir.useFor: Mystery, drama, serious brand films, trailers.

archive-lighttable.name: Archive light table
archive-lighttable.desc: Archive scans on a cool backlit light table: neutral silver-gelatin greys, soft backlight bloom, one orange signal mark kept in colour.
archive-lighttable.useFor: Evidence films, history and archive stories, fact-checks, document reveals, museum and research explainers.

art-deco.name: Art Deco
art-deco.desc: 1930s poster in motion: warm lacquer black, engraved gold ramp with a moving sheen, one burgundy hero accent, gold keyline frame.
art-deco.useFor: Luxury, hotels, galas, jazz, premieres, award reveals, vintage premium brands.

ascii-crt.name: ASCII CRT terminal
ascii-crt.desc: Every picture rebuilt from real monospace glyphs ( .:-+=*%#@) by ink density, lit in amber P3 phosphor on curved dark glass with bloom and scanlines.
ascii-crt.useFor: Hacker/dev stories, logs, retro computing, sci-fi terminals, "the machine is thinking" moments.

backrooms.name: Liminal camcorder (VHS)
backrooms.desc: 1990s camcorder tape: sickly yellow-green grade, per-line time-base jitter, rolling tracking band, chroma bleed, tape snow and dropouts in a 4:3 pillarbox.
backrooms.useFor: Found-footage, liminal / uncanny moods, 90s nostalgia, home-video memories, horror-adjacent teasers.

brick-toy.name: Brick toy macro
brick-toy.desc: Stop-motion toy bricks shot with a macro lens: glossy saturated plastic, crisp highlights, shallow depth of field band, cool neutral grade, on twos.
brick-toy.useFor: Kids and education, building / assembly metaphors, playful product stories, "we built it piece by piece".

briefing-board.name: Engineering briefing board
briefing-board.desc: A real whiteboard wall: warm enamel with window falloff, muted photographs, a sliding reflection sheen, and red reserved for the decision.
briefing-board.useFor: Engineering post-mortems, decision explainers, investigations, strategy walkthroughs.

caption-news.name: Caption news (sound-off)
caption-news.desc: Social-news footage grade: a touch more contrast, a touch less saturation, warm soft-light lift, dark bottom veil for huge captions.
caption-news.useFor: Sound-off social news, data-driven shorts, explainers with big captions and source tags.

cel-anime-80s.name: 80s cel anime (OVA on tape)
cel-anime-80s.desc: Late-80s OVA cels played from videotape on a CRT: flat two-tone luminance bands, coloured (never black) line, violet-lifted shadows, neon halation, chroma bleed, light scanlines, on twos.
cel-anime-80s.useFor: City-pop music videos, retro tech, night city moods, nostalgic brand films, synthwave.

city-symphony.name: Time-lapse symphony
city-symphony.desc: Release-print grade for city footage: desaturated cool greys, a sigmoid S-curve, lifted 7/255 blacks, warm sodium bloom, gentle gate weave, 1.85 matte.
city-symphony.useFor: City films, time-lapse montages, music-driven documentaries, "a day in…" pieces without narration.

countdown.name: Live countdown split-screen
countdown.desc: Event-countdown grade: cool shadows / warm highlights, slight contrast, light radial vignette and grain; hard graphic orange as the only colour accent.
countdown.useFor: Launches, live events, deadlines, mission control, "T-minus" sequences, split-screen comparisons.

crayon-book.name: Crayon picture book
crayon-book.desc: Wax crayon on toothy warm paper: a box of eight crayons, colour broken by the paper grain, indigo (never black) outlines that boil on twos.
crayon-book.useFor: Children’s stories, bedtime tales, charity and family brands, gentle explainers, "drawn by a kid" moments.

dark-keynote.name: Dark tech keynote
dark-keynote.desc: Near-black keynote stage: any frame turned dark-mode with cool slate surfaces, hairline grid, soft glow and a single lime product accent.
dark-keynote.useFor: Software launches, product keynotes, SaaS demos, AI tool reveals, giant-number moments.

data-physical.name: Data physicalization
data-physical.desc: Statistics shot like a studio product: warm greige sweep, soft key light, shallow depth-of-field band, gentle bloom and warm vignette.
data-physical.useFor: Data stories that should feel tangible, annual reports, sustainability figures, premium infographics.

dataviz.name: Data storytelling (pencil on chart paper)
dataviz.desc: Cream chart paper with a dot grid: everything greys into soft graphite, pencil outlines boil gently, and only the data colours keep their hue.
dataviz.useFor: Data journalism, climate and science stories, "one chart, one idea" explainers, annotated graphs.

engraving.name: Copperplate engraving
engraving.desc: Natural-history plate: tone only from swelling hatch lines (three crossing families by darkness), ink contour, laid paper, ruled plate border, and a pale hand-coloured wash.
engraving.useFor: Science and nature history, botanical / zoological plates, heritage brands, scholarly explainers, banknote-like seriousness.

game-show.name: Game show flat
game-show.desc: Candy-flat variety show: every colour snapped to a bright candy set, thick ink outlines, no gradients, no blur.
game-show.useFor: Quizzes, rhythm games, playful brand moments, kids and party content, social reaction formats.

glass-product.name: Glass product render
glass-product.desc: Dark-field launch film: infinite black studio, silver-grey forms, ice-blue/violet light as the only colour, bloom and a hint of prism dispersion.
glass-product.useFor: Hardware and gadget launches, premium tech, audio products, "hear the light" style teasers.

halftone-dossier.name: Halftone dossier
halftone-dossier.desc: Retro printed case file: flat spot inks on cream archive paper, pink misregistered shadow plate, angled blue Ben-Day dots in the darks, dust specks.
halftone-dossier.useFor: True-crime-lite, case files, mystery teasers, character profiles, playful investigations.

hd-2d.name: HD-2D diorama
hd-2d.desc: Pixel art in a lit miniature world: 4 px pixels with ordered dither, a tilt-shift focus band, heavy warm bloom on practical lights, deep vignette.
hd-2d.useFor: Game trailers, RPG-flavoured stories, fantasy towns, nostalgic-but-premium pixel scenes.

hologram-hud.name: Sci-fi hologram HUD
hologram-hud.desc: Scanned holographic wireframe: near-black stage, cyan glowing line work from edges, interlace scanlines, dot grid, amber reserved for locked values.
hologram-hud.useFor: Spec walkthroughs, teardown HUDs, sci-fi product scans, cyber security, mission briefings.

impasto.name: Impasto palette knife
impasto.desc: A moving oil painting: simplified value-planned colour planes raised into knife ridges and lit by a raking light, on canvas weave.
impasto.useFor: Art, culture and travel films, emotional brand stories, rainy city moods, music videos.

iso-infographic.name: Isometric infographic
iso-infographic.desc: Flat three-tone diorama colours snapped to a cream / sea / leaf / coffee-red / soil / mustard set, no outlines on solids, faint isometric lattice.
iso-infographic.useFor: Process explainers ("from bean to cup"), supply chains, city / farm / factory maps, onboarding flows.

kino-montage.name: Constructivist montage
kino-montage.desc: Archive printed as ink on paper: one S-curved ink→paper grade for everything, a single flat constructivist red, paper fibre, flicker, weave and grain.
kino-montage.useFor: History, labour and revolution stories, manifesto films, bold campaigns, archive montages.

lidar-survey.name: LiDAR survey
lidar-survey.desc: Laser returns in a cold dark void: the picture rebuilt as a fine point cloud coloured by a canopy-to-ground ramp, glowing fronts, amber hairline findings.
lidar-survey.useFor: Archaeology and terrain reveals, mapping, surveying, autonomous sensing, "what lies beneath" stories.

living-screencast.name: Living screencast
living-screencast.desc: Screen-recording polish: the frame floats as a window on a warm peach wallpaper mat with a soft inner shadow, a clean warm grade, no grain.
living-screencast.useFor: Product walkthroughs, app demos, feature launches, tutorials, changelog videos.

lowpoly-island.name: Low-poly island
lowpoly-island.desc: Flat-shaded pastel miniature: colours simplified into crisp faceted bands, gentle saturation, soft focus at the frame edges, light bloom.
lowpoly-island.useFor: Travel and tourism, sustainability, game worlds, calm explainers about places and growth.

microgame.name: Microgame frenzy
microgame.desc: Party-game home stage: colours snapped to violet / magenta / gold / cyan toon inks, thick near-black outlines, on twos.
microgame.useFor: Rapid-fire challenges, quiz shorts, game promos, energetic social content, "level up" moments.

microscope.name: Microscope story
microscope.desc: Evidence microscopy: the stain keeps its true colour, glass normalised to a warm paper white with a little density and chroma, gentle local contrast and a light illumination vignette — no false colour, no film look; one cool mint accent for measured readings.
microscope.useFor: Biomedicine, materials science, skincare science, lab and instrument launches, "zoom in to the cell" explainers.

midcentury-toon.name: Mid-century cartoon
midcentury-toon.desc: 1950s classroom-film cartoon: flat atomic-age colour cels printed a few px off a thin, breaking, breathing warm-black ink line, dry-brush tooth in the fills, mottled cream paper, on twos.
midcentury-toon.useFor: How-to guides, rules cards, recipes, numbered steps, friendly retro brand explainers.

news-package.name: Broadcast news package
news-package.desc: Newsroom on-air grade for picture plates: greyscale duotone ink→paper with a firm S-curve, grain and a heavy vignette, so the lemon headline colour is the only hue left.
news-package.useFor: News explainers, bulletins, one-fact-per-screen graphics, data stories with a strap and a bug.

newsreel.name: 1920s newsreel
newsreel.desc: Late-1920s sound newsreel: strictly monochrome warm-silver print inside a rounded 1.37 gate, gate weave, projector flicker, scratches and dust, heavy vignette and grain.
newsreel.useFor: Archive edits, historical explainers, "this week in…" recaps, retro event openers.

one-line.name: One-line drawing
one-line.desc: A single warm-black ink line on mottled cream paper: fills flattened to paper, contours inked with a soft bleed and a slow hand wobble — no tones, no second weight.
one-line.useFor: Poetic brand stories, journeys, timelines, love / memory pieces, minimalist openers.

paper-lantern.name: Paper-cut lightbox
paper-lantern.desc: A backlit shadow box of cut-paper sheets: tones snapped to a night value ladder (bright translucent back, near-black front), relief at every cut edge, warm windows and moons burning through with bloom, pulp mottle.
paper-lantern.useFor: Festive / lunar-new-year stories, bedtime tales, nostalgic city nights, poetry.

paper-popup.name: Paper pop-up book
paper-popup.desc: Saturated cut-paper cards with thick off-white die-cut borders and a grey card edge, standing on a book page under a warm desk lamp (transparent motions get the sticker border).
paper-popup.useFor: Children’s stories, product tours as a storybook, playful onboarding, sticker overlays.

papercut-red.name: Red paper-cut
papercut-red.desc: Window-flower paper cuts: the frame re-laid in indigo night paper layers, every saturated red re-cut as flat China-red paper on top, relief edges and soft paper shadows, hand-cut wobble, on twos.
papercut-red.useFor: Lunar new year, festivals, folk tales, heritage brands, greetings.

pictogram-motion.name: Pictogram motion
pictogram-motion.desc: Beat-locked flash-card identity: the whole frame snapped to five flat tones of one chapter hue (vermilion by default) plus cream, no outlines, no gradients, a whisper of grain.
pictogram-motion.useFor: Event identities, sports / catalogue runs, chaptered lists, bold social countdowns.

pixel-rpg.name: 16-bit pixel RPG
pixel-rpg.desc: A 320×180 indexed-palette world scaled ×6: every colour from a limited RPG palette, gradients only as ordered Bayer dither, no scanlines, no grain, no bloom; sprites on twos.
pixel-rpg.useFor: Game-story explainers, quests and progress, nostalgic product journeys, dialog-box humour.

rubber-hose.name: 1930s rubber-hose cartoon
rubber-hose.desc: Early-sound black-and-white cartoon: warm grey ramp with pure ink and character white at the extremes, boiling ink lines on twos, shown as a worn 35 mm print in a rounded 4:3 gate with flicker, scratches, dust and a hair.
rubber-hose.useFor: Jazz-age gags, retro mascots, vintage music videos, playful brand nostalgia.

satellite-briefing.name: Satellite briefing
satellite-briefing.desc: Analyst grade for imagery: strong local contrast, blue-black → cool-silver ramp with 22 % of the true colour returned, one amber reading kept, light vignette — white is reserved for measurement marks.
satellite-briefing.useFor: OSINT / geography explainers, climate and disaster briefings, before/after over time, logistics maps.

scifi-toon.name: Sci-fi sitcom toon
scifi-toon.desc: Adult-swim-era TV cartoon: flat cel bands, uniform thick purple-black outlines that boil on twos, punchy flat colour — clean digital, no grain, no paper.
scifi-toon.useFor: Absurd comedy explainers, tech parody, reaction-driven shorts, sci-fi gadget reveals.

shadow-puppet.name: Shadow puppetry
shadow-puppet.desc: Dyed-hide puppets on a backlit cotton screen: warm lamp light through the picture, highlights rolling off softly, a lamp hotspot with warm-brown falloff, cloth weave, bloom on the brightest holes.
shadow-puppet.useFor: Folk tales, opera and legend retellings, heritage culture pieces, theatrical storytelling.

silent-film.name: 1920s silent film
silent-film.desc: An inked engraving printed on silver stock and projected: crossed hatching in the darks, ink contours, sepia-toned print, a 4:3 gate in dark velvet drapes, flicker, scratches, burned edges, hand-cranked on twos.
silent-film.useFor: Slapstick gags, intertitle storytelling, vintage product reveals, wordless explainers.

silkscreen-poster.name: Silkscreen travel poster
silkscreen-poster.desc: WPA-style screen print: tones laid as six opaque flat inks from dark foreground to pale sky (depth = value), stepped bands instead of gradients, slipped registration slivers, pinholes in the ink, mottled paper.
silkscreen-poster.useFor: Travel and place stories, national-park / city campaigns, heritage posters, event key art.

spy-titles.name: 60s spy title sequence
spy-titles.desc: Four-ink cut-paper title grammar: black, signal red, mustard and cream by value, scissor-cut wobble edges, ink voids, faint squeegee streaks and paper grain, on twos.
spy-titles.useFor: Title sequences, heist / mystery openers, credits, bold editorial promos.

stained-glass.name: Stained glass
stained-glass.desc: A leaded window in a dark stone hall: simplified jewel-saturated colour pieces, thick lead cames around every shape over a bevelled quarry grid, streaky glass, bloom where light burns through, and a travelling band of sun.
stained-glass.useFor: Heritage and craft stories, secular fables, museum pieces, dramatic reveals by light.

swiss-motion.name: Swiss motion graphics
swiss-motion.desc: International Typographic Style in motion: the frame reduced to black, two light greys and paper on a visible modular grid, with exactly one signal red kept — no texture, no shadow, no glow.
swiss-motion.useFor: Design-led brand films, typographic explainers, data facts, architecture and product principles.

teardown.name: Exploded teardown
teardown.desc: Studio packshot on dark graphite: the frame turned dark-mode with neutral desaturated product greys, lifted near-blacks, emitters blooming, one orange index accent kept, heavy studio vignette.
teardown.useFor: Hardware and product teardowns, spec walkthroughs, "what’s inside", architecture explainers.

telestrator.name: Sports telestrator
telestrator.desc: Pundit’s analysis freeze: footage desaturated by 40 % with cool shadows, a follow spotlight that darkens everything outside the play, and fluorescent marker yellow kept as the one identity colour.
telestrator.useFor: Sports analysis, play breakdowns, "watch this moment" replays, tactical explainers over any footage.

tilt-shift.name: Tilt-shift miniature
tilt-shift.desc: A real place seen as a tabletop model: only a thin horizontal strip sharp, everything above and below melting into blur, saturated freshly-painted colour, sunny warm highlights, light vignette.
tilt-shift.useFor: Cities, travel, logistics, "a day in…" time-lapses, aerial footage and top-down scenes.

ukiyoe.name: Ukiyo-e woodblock
ukiyoe.desc: Edo woodblock print: flat colour blocks in Prussian blues, green and paper by value, a sumi key-line block, blocks slightly out of register, woodgrain and goma-zuri specks, beni red kept for seals, mist bands, double border on washi.
ukiyoe.useFor: Japan-inspired stories, nature and sea, travel, seasonal campaigns, calm heritage openers.

urban-sketch.name: Urban sketch · pen & wash
urban-sketch.desc: A sketchbook page drawn on location: pale transparent washes slipped a few px off a breaking sepia fineliner, pigment pooling at dried edges, granulation in cream cold-press, and the painting fraying before the page edge.
urban-sketch.useFor: Travel diaries, places and neighbourhoods, architecture stories, lifestyle and food journals.

visual-investigation.name: Visual investigation
visual-investigation.desc: Forensic evidence-desk grade: media turned to contrasty neutral greyscale with fine grain, and a single red that only ever points (rings, links, highlights) kept in colour.
visual-investigation.useFor: Fact-checks, incident reconstructions, OSINT timelines, document and footage analysis.

white-model.name: Projection on white model
white-model.desc: A plaster-white massing model in a dark room with data projected as light: everything turned to matte white / grey forms, only saturated colour survives as projected light, with bloom and a deep vignette.
white-model.useFor: Urban data, architecture and planning stories, heat / height / time layers, museum installations.

whiteboard.name: Whiteboard explainer
whiteboard.desc: Dry-erase marker on one glossy board: the frame reduced to black marker, grey ghosts and board white, streaky marker texture, one orange accent marker, and a slow window sheen drifting across the gloss.
whiteboard.useFor: Explainers, lessons, strategy and process walkthroughs, live-drawn arguments.

cel-boil.name: Hand-inked cel boil
cel-boil.desc: Frame-by-frame hand-inked cartoon: colour snapped to a four-colour box (ink, tomato, sunny yellow, cream), fills printed off the ink, every line re-drawn each exposure (boil), paper tooth re-offset per drawing.
cel-boil.useFor: Energetic hand-made explainers, character gags, studio reels, "made by hand" brand moments.

iso-diorama.name: Pastel isometric miniature
iso-diorama.desc: Soft pastel miniature world: lifted lavender shadows, gentle saturation, a lilac studio cast, light bloom on glowing windows and a faint isometric lattice — no hard blacks.
iso-diorama.useFor: City / product ecosystems, SaaS "how it fits together", growth stories, calm tech explainers.

flat-vector-pop.name: Flat vector pop
flat-vector-pop.desc: Showreel-grade flat vector: shapes simplified and snapped to ultramarine, coral, sunflower, mint, cream and deep ink — strictly flat, no outlines, no texture.
flat-vector-pop.useFor: Product explainers, onboarding, upbeat brand reels, social promos with one hero dot.

gold-line-luxe.name: Gold line luxe
gold-line-luxe.desc: One constant-width champagne line on near-black navy: every picture reduced to glowing gold contours, fills sunk into the dark ground, fine grain — quiet luxury.
gold-line-luxe.useFor: Luxury, jewellery and hospitality brands, perfume, premium invitations, elegant openers.

soft-3d-candy.name: Soft 3D candy
soft-3d-candy.desc: Pastel C4D / Octane ident: lifted rosy shadows, a lilac grade, candy highlights blooming pink, soft vignette and 9 % overlay grain.
soft-3d-candy.useFor: App and brand idents, playful product launches, logo stings, social loops.

shape-morph.name: Shape morph
shape-morph.desc: Graphic storytelling with one hero silhouette: every colour snapped to cream, ink, vermilion, marigold and ultramarine fields, with paper luminance texture and fine grain.
shape-morph.useFor: Brand stories told through one shape, logo reveals, icon chains, minimal poster motion.

sticker-explainer.name: Sticker explainer
sticker-explainer.desc: Knowledge-video canvas: cut-out stickers with fat white die-cut outlines and soft lift shadows on a cool off-white dot-grid canvas, colours calmed to slate with one signal orange (transparent motions get the border).
sticker-explainer.useFor: Dense science / tech explainers, "how many X are in Y", supply chains, product anatomy.

cyber-hud-fui.name: Cyberpunk HUD / FUI
cyber-hud-fui.desc: Film-interface grade: the picture as dim cyan-on-teal-black tone, hot white only at the brightest, bloom on light, radial RGB split, fine scanlines, faint panel grid, rec red kept as the only warm colour.
cyber-hud-fui.useFor: Sci-fi interfaces, security / targeting scenes, cyber thrillers, data-heavy tech promos.

collage-cutout.name: Collage cut-out
collage-cutout.desc: Dada / editorial collage: pictures re-printed as aged mono halftone cut-outs on kraft, scissor-rough edges that boil at 10 fps, dust and grain, warm multiply vignette.
collage-cutout.useFor: Editorial and magazine pieces, satire, history and ideas explainers, zine-style promos.

aurora-glass.name: Aurora & liquid glass
aurora-glass.desc: AI-launch calm: the frame mapped into deep indigo with adjacent violet / blue / cyan light pools, frosted softness, wide bloom and a fine anti-banding grain.
aurora-glass.useFor: AI and SaaS product launches, keynote backdrops, premium landing-page loops, glass UI showcases.

bauhaus-kinetic.name: Bauhaus kinetic poster
bauhaus-kinetic.desc: Primary geometry printed as separate knockout plates: every colour snapped to paper, black, red, yellow and blue, a slipped blue plate, rough printed edges, paper tooth and mottle.
bauhaus-kinetic.useFor: Design and architecture stories, structured explainers, posters in motion, beat-locked type.

synthwave-vhs.name: 80s synthwave VHS
synthwave-vhs.desc: OutRun on tape: the frame mapped into a purple-to-sunset ramp, double neon bloom, VHS time-base jitter and chroma bleed, scanlines, snow, a PLAY counter and a heavy vignette.
synthwave-vhs.useFor: Retro music videos, 80s nostalgia promos, gaming / tech throwbacks, night-drive loops.

pixel-quest.name: 16-bit pixel platformer
pixel-quest.desc: A 320×180 platformer on a CRT: 6 px pixels snapped to a sky-blue / grass / sunset master palette with Bayer dither, glow on bright pixels, fat scanlines, curved glass with a soft roll, 10 fps sprites.
pixel-quest.useFor: Game launches, level-up / reward moments, playful progress stories, retro event promos.

liquid-candy.name: Glossy liquid candy
liquid-candy.desc: Thick candy-coloured liquid on a plum set: the frame mapped from deep plum through magenta and pink to warm amber, inflated glossy relief on every shape, pink bloom on highlights.
liquid-candy.useFor: Beverage and beauty brands, playful logo reveals, music visuals, juicy product moments.

variety-hanazi.name: Variety-show 花字
variety-hanazi.desc: Variety-show reaction language: punchy saturated footage, and every transparent element (captions, stickers, emotes) wrapped in a fat white stroke plus a navy outer stroke and a soft lift shadow.
variety-hanazi.useFor: Pet and vlog edits, reaction captions, social shorts, playful product reviews (best on overlay motions).

ortho-tint.name: Orthochromatic print
ortho-tint.desc: 1920s orthochromatic stock: reds and skin go dark, blues go pale, whites drift halfway to amber, one terracotta hero kept in colour inside a heavy iris vignette with flicker and grain.
ortho-tint.useFor: Period drama, silent-era homages with one coloured hero, vintage product heroes.

albumen-print.name: Albumen print
albumen-print.desc: 1880s gold-toned albumen photograph: umber blacks to cream highlights, a faint hand-tint left on saturated subjects, softness, burned edges and a cream card mount.
albumen-print.useFor: History pieces, heritage brands, family archives, Victorian-era stories.

art-nouveau-litho.name: Art Nouveau lithograph
art-nouveau-litho.desc: Decorative panel lithograph: pastel flat colours with one hard shadow tone, doubled warm-brown contours, cream stone-printed paper and a brown keyline frame.
art-nouveau-litho.useFor: Beauty, perfume, tea and wine brands, festivals, elegant portraits, decorative posters.

sea-chart.name: Engraved sea chart
sea-chart.desc: Admiralty-style copperplate chart: sepia engraving tones, fine horizontal burin hatching in the darks, pale hand-tinted washes, a lat/long graticule and a ruled border on laid paper.
sea-chart.useFor: Voyages and routes, exploration history, logistics and trade stories, maps with gravitas.

letterpress-newsprint.name: 1890s letterpress newspaper
letterpress-newsprint.desc: Victorian newspaper page: pictures as fine horizontal line engravings on grey newsprint, ink spreading slightly, specks where ink starved, show-through mottle.
letterpress-newsprint.useFor: Extra! extra! history beats, period news recaps, vintage announcements.

charcoal-erasure.name: Charcoal & eraser
charcoal-erasure.desc: Charcoal animation on toothy paper: rich smudged blacks, tone breaking on the paper grain, eraser-lift streaks and the ghost of earlier drawings, redrawn on twos.
charcoal-erasure.useFor: Memory and history pieces, serious documentaries, poetic essays, protest art.

stone-litho-poster.name: Stone lithograph poster
stone-litho-poster.desc: Wartime three-stone lithograph: muted navy, olive, khaki and brick flats, crayon-grain shadow plate, a navy key line, plates 1–3 px off register, grain boiling on twos.
stone-litho-poster.useFor: Campaign and public-service posters, historical calls to action, civic and industry stories.

glamour-still-bw.name: Glamour still
glamour-still-bw.desc: 1940s airbrushed studio portrait: silky black-and-white with diffusion glow on the highlights, diagonal venetian-blind shadows across the frame, soft vignette.
glamour-still-bw.useFor: Portraits, fashion and beauty, noir-romance teasers, elegant character intros.

typewriter-art.name: Typewriter art
typewriter-art.desc: The picture typed on a mono grid: darker tones get denser glyphs, struck in black ribbon ink on warm typing paper with half-inked, uneven strikes.
typewriter-art.useFor: Writers, archives and memos, retro-tech, poetic openers, "typed into existence" reveals.

picture-magazine.name: Picture-magazine spread
picture-magazine.desc: 1940s photo-essay page: the frame separated into a black 45° halftone and a spot-orange plate at another angle, overprinted on warm coated stock.
picture-magazine.useFor: Photo essays, documentary features, retro editorial spreads, people stories.

wood-type-poster.name: Wood-type letterpress poster
wood-type-poster.desc: Show-print letterpress: three flat solid inks (red, navy, mustard) separated from the frame and printed off register, starved ink and pinholes, laid cream stock.
wood-type-poster.useFor: Gig and event posters, Americana, craft beer and food, bold announcements.

offset-wash.name: Offset wash
offset-wash.desc: Fast ink drawing with bright colour washes deliberately slid well off the line (Fauvist-poster manner): cobalt, lemon and rose patches 20–30 px adrift of a quick black contour on white paper.
offset-wash.useFor: Riviera / travel, fashion and lifestyle, music, joyful brand illustrations.

high-key-bw.name: High-key black & white
high-key-bw.desc: 1950s high-key photograph: most of the frame above mid-grey, lifted shadows, halation blooming around bright edges, white vignette, fine grain.
high-key-bw.useFor: Summer, beach and fashion, wellness, airy nostalgia, clean minimal portraits.

kinescope-tv.name: Kinescope TV
kinescope-tv.desc: A 1950s black-and-white broadcast on a curved tube: cool grey phosphor, soft focus with bloom, scanlines, roll bar and flicker, set in a warm wooden cabinet bezel.
kinescope-tv.useFor: Mid-century broadcast throwbacks, "as seen on TV", retro ads, history of media.

painted-film-poster.name: Painted film poster
painted-film-poster.desc: 1960s hand-painted movie poster: three-value modelling, cool navy shadows against warm amber lights with the subject hue kept, pooled brush edges and canvas texture.
painted-film-poster.useFor: Adventure and epic trailers, heroic key art, retro campaign heroes.

satirical-print.name: Hand-coloured satirical print
satirical-print.desc: Georgian copperplate caricature: cross-hatched etching on cream, with pale watercolour washes laid over by hand and spilling past the lines.
satirical-print.useFor: Political and social satire, history explainers, editorial cartoons, comic period pieces.

fashion-ink-wash.name: Fashion ink & magenta
fashion-ink-wash.desc: Fashion-illustration ink: tones turned into black ink flowing into magenta and pink washes, pooled pigment edges and a swift wobble on white cold-press.
fashion-ink-wash.useFor: Fashion, beauty and theatre, posters for shows, expressive figure drawing.

old-master-glaze.name: Old-master oil glaze
old-master-glaze.desc: Renaissance panel in oil: warm amber varnish, deep chiaroscuro falloff into umber darkness, sculpted local contrast, craquelure across the whole picture and a hint of canvas.
old-master-glaze.useFor: Museum and art-history pieces, luxury storytelling, dramatic portraits, mock-heroic humour.

toy-theatre.name: Toy theatre
toy-theatre.desc: A paper toy theatre: printed card flats with white scissor margins and hard card shadows, flickering candle footlights from below, a red-and-gilt proscenium frame.
toy-theatre.useFor: Stories and fables, theatrical announcements, Victorian whimsy, staged product tales.

pop-silkscreen.name: Pop silkscreen
pop-silkscreen.desc: 1960s photo silkscreen: the picture flattened into garish pink, orange, turquoise and yellow blocks with the black photo plate printed off register on top, squeegee streaks.
pop-silkscreen.useFor: Pop-art portraits, celebrity / product icons, repeat grids, bold social posts.

pushed-16mm.name: Pushed 16 mm
pushed-16mm.desc: Gritty 1970s documentary stock pushed in the lab: cyan shadows, warm-brown mids, harsh local contrast, clumpy grain and a little gate weave.
pushed-16mm.useFor: Documentaries, street and sports stories, raw brand films, 70s throwbacks.

still-light.name: Still light (American realism)
still-light.desc: Quiet realist painting: flat pale institutional planes, muted colour, cool blue shadow over the room and one hard sun parallelogram crossed by window-frame shadows.
still-light.useFor: Loneliness / waiting / city-morning moods, architecture, reflective essays, slow brand films.

egg-tempera.name: Egg tempera
egg-tempera.desc: Dry-brush egg tempera: muted straw, umber and bone, hairline cross-hatched strokes building the tones, a faint wind-combed texture, quiet and lonely.
egg-tempera.useFor: Rural and landscape stories, memory, contemplative brand films, literary adaptations.

block-print-textile.name: Block-print textile
block-print-textile.desc: Hand block-printed cotton: indigo dabu ramp with a madder-red accent block, misregistered stamps, white mud-resist crackle inside the dye, bleed along the weave.
block-print-textile.useFor: Craft and textile brands, Indian heritage stories, slow fashion, artisan processes.

faded-snapshot.name: Faded snapshot
faded-snapshot.desc: Instant-photo album: lifted teal blacks, warm faded colour, soft highlights, a white print border, a warm light leak and gentle grain.
faded-snapshot.useFor: Memories and throwbacks, family and travel montages, lifestyle brands, birthdays.

rococo-silhouette.name: Rococo silhouette
rococo-silhouette.desc: Black cut-paper profiles on candle-warm paper: every form thresholded to solid silhouette with a thin glowing gold rim, a candle halo, inside a velvet-and-gilt frame.
rococo-silhouette.useFor: Period romance, elegant invitations, opera and theatre, refined storytelling.

gongbi-silk.name: Gongbi on silk
gongbi-silk.desc: Chinese court painting: fine iron-wire outlines, mineral colours under an ochre glaze, simplified flat areas, silk weave and an aged warm vignette.
gongbi-silk.useFor: Chinese heritage and court stories, tea and porcelain brands, birds-and-flowers, museum pieces.

airbrush-chrome.name: 80s airbrush chrome
airbrush-chrome.desc: 1980s airbrush illustration: every tone mapped onto banded chrome (navy sky, white horizon, brown earth, orange glow), crisp local contrast, a gliding glint.
airbrush-chrome.useFor: Retro tech and music, sci-fi album art, glossy 80s brand nostalgia.

selective-color-bw.name: Selective colour B&W
selective-color-bw.desc: Hero-colour grade: the whole frame in rich black-and-white with an S-curve and silver grain, and exactly one red subject left in colour.
selective-color-bw.useFor: Pointing at one thing in any scene: the hero product, the one person, the key data series.

illuminated-manuscript.name: Illuminated manuscript
illuminated-manuscript.desc: Medieval vellum page: colours snapped to lapis, vermilion, verdigris, burnished gold and iron-gall ink, ink contours, a gilt frame and a candle glint sweeping the gold.
illuminated-manuscript.useFor: Legends and chronicles, fantasy titles, heritage and rare-book stories, ornate openers.

dv-camcorder.name: 90s DV camcorder
dv-camcorder.desc: Late-90s digital camcorder: crisp-but-cheap picture with a cool cast, over-sharpened edges, slight colour fringing, interlace lines and a blinking REC / date OSD.
dv-camcorder.useFor: Y2K nostalgia, found footage, behind-the-scenes, music videos, home-movie edits.

floor-mosaic.name: Floor mosaic
floor-mosaic.desc: Roman tesserae: the picture laid in small square stones of slightly varied tone with dark grout and a bevel on every tile, glints sliding across the gold.
floor-mosaic.useFor: Antiquity and history, archaeology, Mediterranean brands, tile / craft makers.

chalkboard.name: Chalkboard
chalkboard.desc: Coloured chalk on a slate-green board: tones lifted to chalk white with soft colour, chalk contours broken by board grain, smudged erasures and a wooden frame.
chalkboard.useFor: Lessons and maths, café menus, school and back-to-school, cosy explainers.

silhouette-stage.name: Silhouette stage
silhouette-stage.desc: Black stage, red light: the frame mapped from black through deep red to hot pink-white, figures as backlit silhouettes in haze, a white follow spot and red bloom.
silhouette-stage.useFor: Dance and music performances, theatrical teasers, dramatic reveals, fashion shows.

sodium-night.name: Sodium night
sodium-night.desc: Long-exposure night: cold cyan-teal world against warm sodium-orange lights kept in colour, with horizontal streak bloom so every light becomes a ribbon.
sodium-night.useFor: Night cities and roads, logistics and travel at night, moody music videos, transport stories.

stencil-graffiti.name: Stencil graffiti
stencil-graffiti.desc: Street stencil: three to five flat spray layers (black, red, blue, yellow, off-white) with overspray specks, slightly rough cut edges, on a mottled concrete wall with mortar lines.
stencil-graffiti.useFor: Street culture, activism, urban brands, music and skate, bold social posts.

tech-manual.name: Technical manual
tech-manual.desc: Military technical-manual plate: black line art on sand paper, flat olive and khaki tints by value, a faint grid and a ruled border, animated on twos.
tech-manual.useFor: Equipment and procedure explainers, hardware assembly, safety briefings, retro-industrial brands.

golden-age-comic.name: Golden-age comic
golden-age-comic.desc: Silver-age comic printing: colour separated into a CMYK dot rosette on aged yellow newsprint, heavy black brush contours, muddy-warm paper and slight misregistration.
golden-age-comic.useFor: Superhero-style action, retro comic recaps, pop-culture explainers, bold promos.

daguerreotype.name: Daguerreotype
daguerreotype.desc: A cased silver plate: cool mirror-silver tones with soft bloom, an iridescent tarnish halo creeping in from the edges, set in a brass mat.
daguerreotype.useFor: Portraits from the past, ancestry and archives, historical mystery, elegant intros.

moonlight-oil.name: Moonlight oil
moonlight-oil.desc: Nocturne in oil: the frame mapped into blue-violet, teal and a magenta rim light, short low-contrast brush strokes raised in the paint, canvas weave and a deep vignette.
moonlight-oil.useFor: Night romance, dream and lullaby pieces, melancholy music videos, art-house moods.

underwater-teal.name: Underwater teal
underwater-teal.desc: Below the surface: cool teal-green grade with lifted fog, a shimmering web of caustic light, soft god-ray shafts and bloom on warm practicals.
underwater-teal.useFor: Ocean and diving, aquariums, calm wellness loops, mystery and exploration pieces.

linen-postcard.name: Linen postcard
linen-postcard.desc: Mid-century linen-finish postcard: punchy saturated simplified colour, ink sitting only on the raised threads of a woven texture, a white printed border.
linen-postcard.useFor: Travel and "greetings from" pieces, roadside Americana, tourism campaigns, retro souvenirs.

soft-pastel.name: Soft pastel
soft-pastel.desc: Chalk pastel on grey-violet toned paper: chalky lifted colour, toned-paper grain pressed into every stroke, upright chalk streaks, soft violet edges.
soft-pastel.useFor: Gentle landscapes, skies and seasons, children’s pieces, calm wellness stories.

belle-epoque-litho.name: Belle Époque litho
belle-epoque-litho.desc: Cabaret poster lithograph: flat wobbly plates in acid yellow-green, orange, red and olive, fat loaded-brush black outlines, crachis spatter only in the shadows, cream stock.
belle-epoque-litho.useFor: Nightlife and events, cabarets and festivals, bold figure posters, retro food and drink.

engraved-treatise.name: Engraved treatise
engraved-treatise.desc: Deadpan scientific plates on near-black: white-line engraving by luminance bands, bone type greys, and one hazard-orange signal that is the only thing allowed to glow.
engraved-treatise.useFor: Lyric videos, AI / science essays, banknote-serious explainers, dark technical title sequences.

ink-wash-cartoon.name: Ink-and-wash cartoon
ink-wash-cartoon.desc: Flat 2D cartoon painted in watercolour washes with a boiling tapered ink outline on warm paper: never pure black or white, wet edges, pigment grain, on twos.
ink-wash-cartoon.useFor: Mascot acting, story shorts, warm character explainers, hand-made brand films.

watercolor-storybook.name: Watercolour storybook theatre
watercolor-storybook.desc: A hand-painted picture-book stage show: flat colour washes over paper stains and fibres, wobbly boiling outlines, warm edge vignette, chunky lettering.
watercolor-storybook.useFor: Musical story shorts, karaoke-style sing-alongs, playful narrated tales, warm seasonal campaigns.

cinematic-3d.name: Cinematic golden hour
cinematic-3d.desc: Film-grade golden hour: warm low-sun highlights against teal-lifted shadows, an S-curve, warm haze and bloom around the light, 2.39:1 bars and fine grain — reads as a film, not a viewport.
cinematic-3d.useFor: 3D worlds and terrain fly-throughs, product films, trailers, epic openers.

flat-vector.name: Flat vector (night explainer)
flat-vector.desc: Kurzgesagt-like flat vector on a deep backdrop: shapes simplified into flat tonal bands with no outlines, saturated complementary colour, navy-lifted blacks and a soft radial vignette.
flat-vector.useFor: Science and big-idea explainers, space / biology / economics stories, YouTube essays.

light-editorial-minimal.name: Light editorial minimal
light-editorial-minimal.desc: Warm off-white page, near-black components and a single orange accent: everything else drained to soft warm greys, lifted blacks, no texture — the UI-motion editorial look.
light-editorial-minimal.useFor: UI and product motion, SaaS feature reels, portfolio pieces, editorial type animation.

apple-keynote.name: Premium keynote (light)
apple-keynote.desc: Bright premium product stage: clean light-grey studio, gently lifted shadows and crisp contrast, true colours kept, a soft specular sweep gliding across and a hint of highlight bloom — no grain.
apple-keynote.useFor: Product heroes, feature announcements, device showcases, premium landing loops (light theme).

line-art-mono.name: Monoline line art (线稿)
line-art-mono.desc: Single-weight black contour lines on clean white: fills dissolved to near-white, every shape reduced to its outline, with sparse spot colour where the picture was most saturated.
line-art-mono.useFor: Explainers (especially Chinese 线稿 requests), process diagrams, onboarding, light-humour doodles.

anime-cel.name: Anime cel
anime-cel.desc: Modern TV-anime cel look: clean thin ink lines, colour flattened into two-to-three cel tones, bright saturated skies, soft bloom on highlights — crisp digital, no tape, no grain.
anime-cel.useFor: Character stories, dramatic reveals, music videos, anime-styled social shorts.

clay-3d.name: Claymation
clay-3d.desc: Matte plasticine: colours simplified into soft clay forms, warm muted grade, fingerprint-bumpy surface relief under a soft key light, stop-motion stepping on twos.
clay-3d.useFor: Friendly brand mascots, kids’ content, cosy explainers, stop-motion style loops.

math-3b1b.name: Maths on slate
math-3b1b.desc: Maths-video language: dark slate ground, every colour snapped to white and a few meaning-colours (blue, yellow, green, red), a faint glow on the strokes — no decoration.
math-3b1b.useFor: Maths and physics explainers, function plots, equation walkthroughs, algorithm visualisations.

brainrot-chaos.name: Brainrot chaos
brainrot-chaos.desc: Maximal meme energy: crushed over-saturated colour, a hard S-curve, crunchy over-sharpening, RGB split fringes and noisy grain — loud but captions stay readable.
brainrot-chaos.useFor: Meme edits, reaction shorts, gaming clips, deliberately chaotic social content.

vhs-home.name: VHS home video
vhs-home.desc: A neutral home-video tape: soft analogue picture with lifted blacks, per-line time-base jitter, a rolling tracking band, chroma bleeding right, tape snow and dropouts, fine scanlines and a PLAY counter.
vhs-home.useFor: Nostalgia, found footage, horror openers, retro birthday / family edits.

manga-bw.name: Manga black & white
manga-bw.desc: Pure black-and-white manga page: tones turned into screentone dots, bold ink contours, white paper — no grey wash, no colour.
manga-bw.useFor: Manga-style stories, dramatic reveals, action beats, comic recaps in monochrome.

voxel-studio.name: Voxel clay studio
voxel-studio.desc: Matte toy-product calm: warm off-white seamless studio, soft shadows, one saturated orange accent against warm greys, no texture, no outlines.
voxel-studio.useFor: Product loops, app icons in motion, build/assemble metaphors, quiet premium explainers.

swiss-reel.name: Swiss motion reel
swiss-reel.desc: Flat editorial colour fields: warm paper, red-orange, ultramarine and black chapters, light grain, soft vignette, no gradients inside shapes.
swiss-reel.useFor: Motion-design reels, principle explainers, type-led brand films, portfolio openers.

ink-hatch-3d.name: Ink-hatched clay
ink-hatch-3d.desc: White clay world drawn with pen: ink contours and 45° hatching in the shade, warm paper greys, and only the saturated "energy" colours kept glowing.
ink-hatch-3d.useFor: Science textbooks in motion, physics explainers, pop-up-book lessons, museum interactives.

storybook-gouache.name: Storybook gouache
storybook-gouache.desc: Cosy hand-painted gouache: terracotta and cream grade with lifted warm blacks, thin warm-brown ink lines, fine paper grain, sunbeam bloom.
storybook-gouache.useFor: Cosy product promos, children’s brands, autumn / holiday campaigns, "made with love" stories.

paper-diorama.name: Paper-cut diorama
paper-diorama.desc: Layered cut paper: flattened colour planes with pale torn rims, paper fibre in every layer, deep shadows between planes, one warm guide light.
paper-diorama.useFor: Storybook journeys, heritage and craft brands, calm narrated shorts, title sequences.

klein-terminal.name: Klein-blue terminal
klein-terminal.desc: Saturated International-Klein-blue screen: everything mapped to blue with white line work, scanlines, red-left / cyan-right RGB split and grain — medieval meets machine.
klein-terminal.useFor: AI-agent demos, strategy game promos, hacker-gothic brand moments, bold tech teasers.

arcade-halftone.name: Spider-Verse arcade
arcade-halftone.desc: Comic-printed 3D: punchy saturated colour, halftone dots grown into the shadows, spray-grain speckle, magenta/cyan chromatic rims, neon bloom.
arcade-halftone.useFor: Versus / battle promos, game launches, hype shorts, music drops, sports face-offs.

iso-workbench.name: Isometric drafting workbench
iso-workbench.desc: Technical illustration on warm drafting paper: flat cel tones, dark navy outlines, soft warm-brown shadows, faint ±30° iso grid, one teal accent.
iso-workbench.useFor: Hardware tutorials, maker / electronics content, assembly guides, product documentation in motion.
